LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Welc:
Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.
Please take the time to enjoy our collection of fantastic artwork featuring POKéMON.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCu:
I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of fine arts.
It's heartening to see someone so young as you in our MUSEUM.
Have you viewed our collection of paintings already?
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotD: Ah, then let me not disturb you. Please, do take your time.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Have:
Oh? I do believe that you seem to be a POKéMON TRAINER.
Have you an interest in paintings, too?
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Hono:
I see…
I'm honored that you would visit us in spite of that.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Exce:
Ah, excellent! You do like paintings!
Then, may I ask you to come with me?
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Very: It's a very old painting. The paint is peeling here and there.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddL: It's an odd landscape with bizarre and fantastic scenery.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Pain: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling woman with a POKéMON on her lap.

It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON from long ago.
The artist painted this from imagination.

It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON swaying in a breeze.
They appear to be enjoying the wind's gentle caress.

It's a delicious-looking painting of BERRIES.
This painting could make you hungry!
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPok:
It's a replica of a famous sculpture.
It depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigP:
It's a big POKé BALL carved from a black stone.
It was apparently used in festivals in the olden days.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Ston: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed with POKéMON and dense text in the small characters of an ancient, unreadable language.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Work: Hmmm… What works of great magnificence…
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Must:
Battling with POKéMON is fun, I'll grant you that.
But one mustn't forget our love for the fine arts.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_This:
This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could see many fantastic paintings.
And the CURATOR is a wonderful person.
Among artists like myself, this MUSEUM is an inspiration.
This lady is pretty! She's like Mommy!
This POKéMON is adorable! Just like our little boy!
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Hear:
I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got in some new paintings.
So, naturally I hurried over.
Are the new paintings up on the second floor?
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Cura:
Lately, the CURATOR has been unusually cheerful.
I bet something good happened for him. Definitely.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimT:
I aim to see many great paintings here and learn from them.
I have this dream of one day having my artwork exhibited here.
LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Muse:
The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite tourist destination.
It's great for LILYCOVE… No, great for the HOENN region!
This is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER procured all the paintings upstairs.
